title: Cosmo session arranged by Edward Frank
summary: A Cosmo single Ridgley wrote, arranged by Edward Frank, who also botched the first Live While You Can; Skip Godwin engineered.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: Okay, that's Cosmo. Yeah, for Cosmo? Yeah, now we did this, Edward Frank, Edward Frank did the arrangement on this. And this was done during the time I did for Cosmo, Live While You Can. See, I recorded Live While You Can for Cosmo, too.

But I re-recorded it for Mr. Walker because Edward Frank did a lousy job on it. It was lousy. And they never put it out. But it was lousy. We recognized it was a good tune. That's why I re-did it with the thing. But this is an interesting tune. You don't hear that.
Hey, Little Chick, no, I don't hear that one.

This sounds good. You'd be surprised how well this thing sounds. Did you write that? Uh-huh. I wrote both sides of this. Do you know any musicians you used on that track? No, I can't remember because Edward Frank. Was Edward Frank?
He contacted the musicians. I can't remember who was the musicians on that. I know one thing, they all could play because they had written music. I remember that. But they had charts.
Yeah, and Skip was an engineer.
